q: 我要三斤苹果___。
zh: 我要三斤苹果。
py: wǒ yào sān jīn píng guǒ
en: I'd like three jin of apples.
why: 要 + noun means "want"; it is an order, not an about-to event, so there is no final 了.

q: 我的女儿___六岁了。
zh: 我的女儿快六岁了。
py: wǒ de nǚ ér kuài liù suì le
en: My daughter is almost six.
why: 快 goes straight before an age with no verb and ends in 了. 才 means "only" and 刚 means "just", so neither says "almost".

s: 天马上就要黑了，我们快点买菜吧。
s_py: tiān mǎ shàng jiù yào hēi le wǒ men kuài diǎn mǎi cài ba
zh: 天马上就要黑了，我们快点买菜吧。
py: tiān mǎ shàng jiù yào hēi le wǒ men kuài diǎn mǎi cài ba
en: It's about to get dark; let's buy groceries quickly.
why: 马上 goes before 就要, and both precede the verb. It is correct and 了 closes the clause.

s: 我弟弟快是八岁了。
s_py: wǒ dì di kuài shì bā suì le
zh: 我弟弟快八岁了。
py: wǒ dì di kuài bā suì le
en: My younger brother is almost eight.
why: 快 goes directly before the age; Chinese does not insert 是 here.

task: Say it is about to pour, using 要 (no time word).
zh: 要下大雨了。
py: yào xià dà yǔ le
en: It's about to pour.
why: Drop the past time word and put 要 before the verb: 要…了 says the rain has not started yet but is about to.

s: 还有一个月，房租就要涨了。
s_py: hái yǒu yī gè yuè fáng zū jiù yào zhǎng le
zh: 还有一个月，房租就要涨了。
py: hái yǒu yī gè yuè fáng zū jiù yào zhǎng le
en: The rent goes up in a month.
why: A countdown like 还有一个月 calls for 就要…了, with the time phrase before 就要 and 了 at the end. It is correct as written.

q: 她下周一___去新公司上班了。
zh: 她下周一就要去新公司上班了。
py: tā xià zhōu yī jiù yào qù xīn gōng sī shàng bān le
en: She starts work at her new company next Monday.
why: 下周一 names a specific day, so use 就要…了. 快 and 快要 are vague and cannot go with it.

s: 房东下个月要涨房租了。
s_py: fáng dōng xià gè yuè yào zhǎng fáng zū le
zh: 房东下个月要涨房租了。
py: fáng dōng xià gè yuè yào zhǎng fáng zū le
en: The landlord is raising the rent next month.
why: Plain 要…了 is also correct with a time word, unlike 快 and 快要. The sentence is fine.

s: 快商店关门了。
s_py: kuài shāng diàn guān mén le
zh: 商店快关门了。
py: shāng diàn kuài guān mén le
en: The shop is about to close.
why: 快 is an adverb and must come after the subject, directly before the verb. English "soon the shop closes" cannot be copied.

q: 这个月的钱快用完___，不能再买了。
zh: 这个月的钱快用完了，不能再买了。
py: zhè gè yuè de qián kuài yòng wán le bù néng zài mǎi le
en: This month's money is almost used up, so I can't buy any more.
why: The about-to pattern needs 了 at the end of the clause. 的 would turn 快用完 into a modifier and leave the clause unfinished.

q: 明天我们___交房租了，今天得去取钱。
zh: 明天我们就要交房租了，今天得去取钱。
py: míng tiān wǒ men jiù yào jiāo fáng zū le jīn tiān děi qù qǔ qián
en: We have to pay the rent tomorrow, so I must go and get cash today.
why: 明天 is a specific time, so 就要 is needed. 快 and 快要 cannot be paired with 明天.

q: 商店快关门___，我们快点买。
zh: 商店快关门了，我们快点买。
py: shāng diàn kuài guān mén le wǒ men kuài diǎn mǎi
en: The shop is about to close, so let's buy quickly.
why: 快 + verb is closed by 了, which marks the situation that is about to arrive. 过 would say it has closed before and 着 describes a state, so neither completes 快关门.

zh: 超市马上就要关门了。
py: chāo shì mǎ shàng jiù yào guān mén le
en: The supermarket is about to close any moment.
why: 马上 comes before 就要 and 就要 before the verb 关门; 了 stays at the end.

task: Say he is almost thirty, using 快.
zh: 他快三十岁了。
py: tā kuài sān shí suì le
en: He's almost thirty.
why: 快 goes directly before the age and the sentence needs the closing 了; no verb is added.

q: 现在___十点了，我们回家吧。
zh: 现在快十点了，我们回家吧。
py: xiàn zài kuài shí diǎn le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's almost ten o'clock now; let's go home.
why: "Almost" before a clock time is 快 + time + 了. 刚 and 才 mean "just" and "only", and 是 makes a plain statement of the time.

q: 你来得太晚了，最后一件___卖掉了。
zh: 你来得太晚了，最后一件已经卖掉了。
py: nǐ lái de tài wǎn le zuì hòu yī jiàn yǐ jīng mài diào le
en: You came too late; the last one has already been sold.
why: 来得太晚了 says the sale is over, so 已经…了 is the completed pattern. 快要, 就要 and 要 would say it is still available.

q: 这件衣服___三百块了，太贵了。
zh: 这件衣服快三百块了，太贵了。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu kuài sān bǎi kuài le tài guì le
en: This piece of clothing is almost three hundred yuan; it is too expensive.
why: 快 + amount + 了 means "nearly that much". 只 and 才 both mean "only", which clashes with 太贵了.

q: 他___搬走了，你找不到他了。
zh: 他搬走了，你找不到他了。
py: tā bān zǒu le nǐ zhǎo bù dào tā le
en: He has moved away; you cannot find him any more.
why: The moving is finished, so 搬走了 stands alone. Adding 要, 快 or 就要 would say he is still here and about to go.

src_py: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ zhù le bā nián
task: Say it is almost eight years, using 快.
zh: 我们在这里住了快八年了。
py: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ zhù le kuài bā nián le
en: We have lived here for almost eight years.
why: 快 goes directly before 八年 and a final 了 is added after it; the verb 住了 stays before 快.

src_py: xiǎo wáng xià zhōu bān jiā
zh: 小王下周就要搬家了。
py: xiǎo wáng xià zhōu jiù yào bān jiā le
en: Xiao Wang is moving next week.
why: The time word 下周 precedes 就要, before or after the subject, and 了 closes the sentence.

q: 老板___走了，你快去问问价格。
zh: 老板要走了，你快去问问价格。
py: lǎo bǎn yào zǒu le nǐ kuài qù wèn wen jià gé
en: The boss is about to leave; go and ask about the price quickly.
why: He is still there and about to leave, so 要…了. 已经走了 would mean he is gone, so there would be nobody left to ask.

q: 房东说下个月就要涨房租___。
zh: 房东说下个月就要涨房租了。
py: fáng dōng shuō xià gè yuè jiù yào zhǎng fáng zū le
en: The landlord says the rent is going up next month.
why: 就要 + verb must end in 了. 过 means it has happened before, which clashes with 下个月, and 着 cannot close this pattern.

q: 你快到家___吗？
zh: 你快到家了吗？
py: nǐ kuài dào jiā le ma
en: Are you nearly home?
why: The question keeps the pattern 快…了 and puts 吗 after 了. 呢 or 着 cannot stand in for the final 了.

q: 买二手房，你一定要看看房子的水电___。
zh: 买二手房，你一定要看看房子的水电。
py: mǎi èr shǒu fáng nǐ yí dìng yào kàn kan fáng zi de shuǐ diàn
en: When buying a second-hand flat, you must check the water and electricity.
why: 一定要 expresses obligation and gives advice, so no 了. 了 would suggest the checking is about to happen.

q: 下个星期我们___搬进新家了。
zh: 下个星期我们就要搬进新家了。
py: xià gè xīng qī wǒ men jiù yào bān jìn xīn jiā le
en: We're moving into our new home next week.
why: 下个星期 names a specific time, which calls for 就要. 快 and 快要 would only say "soon" and sound wrong after a named week.

q: 昨天我们___签合同了，今天就可以搬进去。
zh: 昨天我们签合同了，今天就可以搬进去。
py: zuó tiān wǒ men qiān hé tóng le jīn tiān jiù kě yǐ bān jìn qù
en: We signed the contract yesterday, so we can move in today.
why: 昨天 is past, so 签合同了 is complete. 要 and 快要 look forward and cannot go with 昨天.

q: 这个小区的新超市快要开业___，大家都很高兴。
zh: 这个小区的新超市快要开业了，大家都很高兴。
py: zhè gè xiǎo qū de xīn chāo shì kuài yào kāi yè le dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
en: The new supermarket in this neighbourhood is about to open, and everyone is happy.
why: The pattern 快要…了 closes with 了 after the whole verb phrase. 的 would make 快要开业 a modifier and the sentence would have no predicate.

q: 他在这家超市工作___两年了。
zh: 他在这家超市工作快两年了。
py: tā zài zhè jiā chāo shì gōng zuò kuài liǎng nián le
en: He has worked in this supermarket for almost two years.
why: 快 + length of time + 了 means "nearly that long". 才 and 刚 point to a short time ("only", "just"), and 是 is not used here.

q: 后天这件衣服的优惠___结束了，你想买就得今天决定。
zh: 后天这件衣服的优惠就要结束了，你想买就得今天决定。
py: hòu tiān zhè jiàn yī fu de yōu huì jiù yào jié shù le nǐ xiǎng mǎi jiù děi jīn tiān jué dìng
en: The discount on this piece of clothing ends the day after tomorrow, so if you want it you must decide today.
why: 后天 is a specific day, so 就要 is needed. 快 and 快要 can only be used when no time is named.

s: 他在这家店打工快一年了。
s_py: tā zài zhè jiā diàn dǎ gōng kuài yī nián le
zh: 他在这家店打工快一年了。
py: tā zài zhè jiā diàn dǎ gōng kuài yī nián le
en: He has been working part-time in this shop for almost a year.
why: 快 + length of time + 了 is correct even after a verb phrase. No 是 or extra verb is needed.

zh: 我们快要买新房子了。
py: wǒ men kuài yào mǎi xīn fáng zi le
en: We're about to buy a new house.
why: 快要 is placed before the verb and 了 comes after the object 新房子, at the very end.

zh: 新手机后天就要到了。
py: xīn shǒu jī hòu tiān jiù yào dào le
en: The new phone arrives the day after tomorrow.
why: 后天 comes before 就要, and may stand before or after the subject; 就要 stays directly before 到.

q: 我要两瓶水___，谢谢。
zh: 我要两瓶水，谢谢。
py: wǒ yào liǎng píng shuǐ xiè xie
en: I'd like two bottles of water, please.
why: 要 + counted noun is a request, so no 了. 了 is only for events that are about to happen.

zh: 这件衣服快卖完了。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu kuài mài wán le
en: This piece of clothing is almost sold out.
why: 快 stands before the verb 卖完 and 了 ends the sentence. 快 cannot move after the verb.

s: 火车没要开了，你不用着急。
s_py: huǒ chē méi yào kāi le nǐ bù yòng zháo jí
zh: 火车还没开呢，你不用着急。
py: huǒ chē hái méi kāi ne nǐ bù yòng zháo jí
en: The train hasn't left yet, so there's no need to hurry.
why: 要…了 cannot be negated with 没. "Not yet" is 还没 + verb, usually with 呢.

s: 我还没到家呢，你们先吃饭吧。
s_py: wǒ hái méi dào jiā ne nǐ men xiān chī fàn ba
zh: 我还没到家呢，你们先吃饭吧。
py: wǒ hái méi dào jiā ne nǐ men xiān chī fàn ba
en: I'm not home yet; go ahead and eat.
why: "Not yet" is 还没 + verb + 呢, so this is correct. The about-to pattern is not negated.

zh: 还有五分钟商店就要关门了。
py: hái yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng shāng diàn jiù yào guān mén le
en: The shop closes in five minutes.
why: The countdown comes before 就要, either before or after the subject. 就要 stays directly before 关门.

s: 后天商场就要开业了。
s_py: hòu tiān shāng chǎng jiù yào kāi yè le
zh: 后天商场就要开业了。
py: hòu tiān shāng chǎng jiù yào kāi yè le
en: The shopping centre opens the day after tomorrow.
why: 后天 is a specific day, so 就要…了 is the right form, with the time word before 就要. The sentence is correct.

zh: 我们快要到新家了。
py: wǒ men kuài yào dào xīn jiā le
en: We're almost at our new home.
why: 了 goes at the very end, after the object 新家. 快要到了新家 would wrongly put 了 between the verb and its object.

q: 房东今年___七十岁了，还每天亲自来收房租。
zh: 房东今年快七十岁了，还每天亲自来收房租。
py: fáng dōng jīn nián kuài qī shí suì le hái měi tiān qīn zì lái shōu fáng zū
en: The landlord is almost seventy this year, yet he still comes to collect the rent himself every day.
why: 快 + age + 了 means "nearly that age". 刚 and 才 would say he has only just reached it, and 是 cannot combine with 快 here.

q: 明天早上八点，装修工人___来了。
zh: 明天早上八点，装修工人就要来了。
py: míng tiān zǎo shang bā diǎn zhuāng xiū gōng rén jiù yào lái le
en: The renovation workers will be here at eight tomorrow morning.
why: 明天早上八点 is a precise time, so 就要. 快 and 快要 do not combine with it.

s: 昨天我们快要买了一套新沙发。
s_py: zuó tiān wǒ men kuài yào mǎi le yī tào xīn shā fā
zh: 昨天我们买了一套新沙发。
py: zuó tiān wǒ men mǎi le yī tào xīn shā fā
en: We bought a new sofa yesterday.
why: 快要 looks forward and cannot go with the past time 昨天. For a finished purchase use 买了 alone.

q: 买东西以前，你要先看看价格___。
zh: 买东西以前，你要先看看价格。
py: mǎi dōng xi yǐ qián nǐ yào xiān kàn kan jià gé
en: Before you buy something, you should check the price first.
why: Here 要 gives advice ("should"). Advice does not take the about-to 了, which would turn it into an event that is about to happen.

zh: 房东下个月就要把房子卖掉了。
py: fáng dōng xià gè yuè jiù yào bǎ fáng zi mài diào le
en: The landlord is selling the flat next month.
why: 下个月 precedes 就要, which goes before the 把 phrase and verb. 了 ends the sentence.

q: ___十二点了，我们去超市买菜吧。
zh: 快十二点了，我们去超市买菜吧。
py: kuài shí èr diǎn le wǒ men qù chāo shì mǎi cài ba
en: It's almost twelve; let's go to the supermarket to buy groceries.
why: "Almost" + clock time is 快 + time + 了. 刚 and 才 mean "just" and "only", and 是 does not give the meaning "almost".

q: 现在已经八点五十了，超市九点___关门了。
zh: 现在已经八点五十了，超市九点就要关门了。
py: xiàn zài yǐ jīng bā diǎn wǔ shí le chāo shì jiǔ diǎn jiù yào guān mén le
en: It's already ten to nine, and the supermarket closes at nine.
why: 九点 is a specific clock time, so 就要…了. 快 and 快要 are for a vague "soon" and do not go with a named time.

zh: 大家快放假了。
py: dà jiā kuài fàng jià le
en: Everyone is about to go on holiday.
why: 快 sits after the subject and directly before 放假. It cannot go before 大家 or after 放假.

q: 我们快要到___商场___。
zh: 我们快要到商场了。
py: wǒ men kuài yào dào shāng chǎng le
en: We're about to reach the shopping centre.
why: In the about-to pattern 了 goes at the very end, after the object. 到了商场 would say the arrival is already complete, which contradicts 快要.

zh: 超市快关门了。
py: chāo shì kuài guān mén le
en: The supermarket is about to close.
why: 快 is an adverb after the subject and directly before 关门; the final 了 closes the sentence.

s: 服务员，我要一杯咖啡了。
s_py: fú wù yuán wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi le
zh: 服务员，我要一杯咖啡。
py: fú wù yuán wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi
en: Waiter, I'd like a cup of coffee.
why: 要 + noun means "want" and never takes the about-to 了; adding 了 is wrong.

q: 小王刚才___走了，你现在追不上他了。
zh: 小王刚才走了，你现在追不上他了。
py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái zǒu le nǐ xiàn zài zhuī bù shàng tā le
en: Xiao Wang left just now; you cannot catch up with him now.
why: 刚才 is past and 追不上 shows he has gone, so plain 走了 is needed. 要 and 快要 would mean he has not left yet.

zh: 现在快十点了。
py: xiàn zài kuài shí diǎn le
en: It's almost ten o'clock now.
why: 快 goes directly before the clock time, with no verb, and the sentence ends in 了.

zh: 明天我就要去交房租了。
py: míng tiān wǒ jiù yào qù jiāo fáng zū le
en: I'm going to pay the rent tomorrow.
why: The time word precedes 就要, either before or after the subject, and 就要 stays right before the verb phrase.

q: 下个星期三，楼下的新商场___开业了，到时候买东西会很方便。
zh: 下个星期三，楼下的新商场就要开业了，到时候买东西会很方便。
py: xià gè xīng qī sān lóu xià de xīn shāng chǎng jiù yào kāi yè le dào shí hou mǎi dōng xi huì hěn fāng biàn
en: The new shopping centre downstairs opens next Wednesday, and shopping will be very convenient then.
why: 下个星期三 is a specific day, so 就要…了. 快 and 快要 do not accept a named day.

s: 我下个月要搬到新房子里去。
s_py: wǒ xià gè yuè yào bān dào xīn fáng zi lǐ qù
zh: 我下个月要搬到新房子里去。
py: wǒ xià gè yuè yào bān dào xīn fáng zi lǐ qù
en: I'm going to move into the new place next month.
why: A plan stated for a later time uses plain 要 without 了. It is correct as it stands; 了 is only needed for something about to happen.

q: 我女儿说，她以后要自己买房子___，不想靠父母。
zh: 我女儿说，她以后要自己买房子，不想靠父母。
py: wǒ nǚ ér shuō tā yǐ hòu yào zì jǐ mǎi fáng zi bù xiǎng kào fù mǔ
en: My daughter says that in the future she wants to buy a flat herself and not rely on her parents.
why: 以后 marks a distant intention, so 要 means "want to" and takes no 了. 了 would make it sound like she is about to buy one right now.

q: 店员正在关灯，商店要关门___，我们明天再来。
zh: 店员正在关灯，商店要关门了，我们明天再来。
py: diàn yuán zhèng zài guān dēng shāng diàn yào guān mén le wǒ men míng tiān zài lái
en: The assistants are turning off the lights and the shop is about to close, so let's come back tomorrow.
why: With the lights going off, the closing is about to happen, so 要 needs the final 了. Without it 要 would read as a general "will / wants to".

zh: 我快没钱了。
py: wǒ kuài méi qián le
en: I'm almost out of money.
why: 快 comes before 没钱 and 了 closes the sentence; 快 cannot follow 没钱.

src_py: fáng dōng míng tiān lái shōu fáng zū
zh: 房东明天就要来收房租了。
py: fáng dōng míng tiān jiù yào lái shōu fáng zū le
en: The landlord is coming to collect the rent tomorrow.
why: 明天 is a specific time, so 就要 goes before the verb phrase and 了 closes the sentence.

s: 房东快要收了房租。
s_py: fáng dōng kuài yào shōu le fáng zū
zh: 房东快要收房租了。
py: fáng dōng kuài yào shōu fáng zū le
en: The landlord is about to collect the rent.
why: The 了 of the about-to pattern goes at the end, after the object. 收了房租 would mean the rent has already been collected, which clashes with 快要.

q: 邻居三天前___搬走了，房子现在是空的。
zh: 邻居三天前搬走了，房子现在是空的。
py: lín jū sān tiān qián bān zǒu le fáng zi xiàn zài shì kōng de
en: The neighbours moved out three days ago, and the flat is empty now.
why: 三天前 puts the move in the past, so 搬走了 is a completed action. 要, 快要 and 快 look forward and cannot go with a past time.

q: 你们的新房子快装修好___吗？
zh: 你们的新房子快装修好了吗？
py: nǐ men de xīn fáng zi kuài zhuāng xiū hǎo le ma
en: Is your new place almost finished being renovated?
why: To ask, add 吗 after the final 了, as in 快…了吗. 过 and 着 are not part of the pattern.

q: 先生，您要什么颜色___？
zh: 先生，您要什么颜色？
py: xiān sheng nín yào shén me yán sè
en: Sir, what colour would you like?
why: 要 + noun asks what someone wants, and 了 never follows this 要. 了 is only for something about to happen.

q: 你要大的还是小的___？
zh: 你要大的还是小的？
py: nǐ yào dà de hái shi xiǎo de
en: Do you want the big one or the small one?
why: 要 + noun means "want" and offers a choice. An about-to 了 makes no sense when picking between items.

src_py: fáng zi kuài zhuāng xiū hǎo le
task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 房子快装修好了吗？
py: fáng zi kuài zhuāng xiū hǎo le ma
en: Is the flat almost finished being renovated?
why: 吗 is added after the final 了, never before it, and the pattern itself stays unchanged.

q: 下周五，房东___回国了，房租得提前交。
zh: 下周五，房东就要回国了，房租得提前交。
py: xià zhōu wǔ fáng dōng jiù yào huí guó le fáng zū děi tí qián jiāo
en: The landlord goes back to his country next Friday, so the rent has to be paid early.
why: 下周五 is a specific day, so 就要…了. 快 and 快要 stay vague and do not combine with a named day.

s: 房东已经走了，你明天再来吧。
s_py: fáng dōng yǐ jīng zǒu le nǐ míng tiān zài lái ba
zh: 房东已经走了，你明天再来吧。
py: fáng dōng yǐ jīng zǒu le nǐ míng tiān zài lái ba
en: The landlord has already left; come again tomorrow.
why: 已经 + 了 marks a completed action, and no 要 is needed. The sentence is correct.

q: 你看，火车要开___，快上车！
zh: 你看，火车要开了，快上车！
py: nǐ kàn huǒ chē yào kāi le kuài shàng chē
en: Look, the train is about to leave; get on quickly!
why: The train is about to leave right now, so 要…了 is needed. Bare 要 would not express that urgency.

q: 这个星期六，新冰箱___送到了，我们得先把厨房收拾一下。
zh: 这个星期六，新冰箱就要送到了，我们得先把厨房收拾一下。
py: zhè gè xīng qī liù xīn bīng xiāng jiù yào sòng dào le wǒ men děi xiān bǎ chú fáng shōu shi yī xià
en: The new fridge is being delivered this Saturday, so we need to tidy the kitchen first.
why: 这个星期六 is a specific day, so 就要…了. 快 and 快要 are for an unspecified "soon" and do not go with a named day.

q: 这家店的苹果快卖完___，你要买就快点。
zh: 这家店的苹果快卖完了，你要买就快点。
py: zhè jiā diàn de píng guǒ kuài mài wán le nǐ yào mǎi jiù kuài diǎn
en: The apples in this shop are nearly sold out; if you want some, be quick.
why: 快卖完 is the about-to pattern and ends with 了. 过 would mean they were sold out at some earlier time, which the urgency of 快点 rules out.

s: 楼上的邻居快搬家着。
s_py: lóu shàng de lín jū kuài bān jiā zhe
zh: 楼上的邻居快搬家了。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū kuài bān jiā le
en: The neighbour upstairs is about to move.
why: The about-to pattern is closed by 了. 着 marks a continuing state and cannot end 快…。

s: 快要到春节了，商店里的东西都在打折。
s_py: kuài yào dào chūn jié le shāng diàn lǐ de dōng xi dōu zài dǎ zhé
zh: 快要到春节了，商店里的东西都在打折。
py: kuài yào dào chūn jié le shāng diàn lǐ de dōng xi dōu zài dǎ zhé
en: Spring Festival is almost here, and everything in the shops is on sale.
why: 了 comes after the object 春节, at the end of the clause, which is exactly right for 快要到…了.

s: 明天我就要去看房子了。
s_py: míng tiān wǒ jiù yào qù kàn fáng zi le
zh: 明天我就要去看房子了。
py: míng tiān wǒ jiù yào qù kàn fáng zi le
en: I'm going to look at flats tomorrow.
why: A time word can stand before the subject, as long as it comes before 就要. The sentence is correct.

task: Say he is about to go back to his country, using 要.
zh: 他要回国了。
py: tā yào huí guó le
en: He's about to go back to his country.
why: 要 before the verb with 了 at the end says it is about to happen; the plain 回国了 says it already did.

q: ___春节了，商场里的人越来越多。
zh: 快春节了，商场里的人越来越多。
py: kuài chūn jié le shāng chǎng lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō
en: It's almost Spring Festival, and there are more and more people in the shopping centre.
why: 快 + festival + 了 means "the festival is almost here". 才 and 刚 mean "only" and "just", and 是 would need a different sentence.

q: 房东说，月底他___来收房租了。
zh: 房东说，月底他就要来收房租了。
py: fáng dōng shuō yuè dǐ tā jiù yào lái shōu fáng zū le
en: The landlord says he's coming to collect the rent at the end of the month.
why: 月底 is a fixed point in time, so 就要…了 is used. 快 and 快要 do not go with a named time.

task: Say it is about to sell out, using 快.
zh: 面包快卖完了。
py: miàn bāo kuài mài wán le
en: The bread is almost sold out.
why: 快 before 卖完 changes "sold out" into "about to sell out"; 了 stays at the end.

s: 你们快搬家吗了？
s_py: nǐ men kuài bān jiā ma le
zh: 你们快搬家了吗？
py: nǐ men kuài bān jiā le ma
en: Are you about to move?
why: 吗 comes after the final 了, never before it.

q: 离房租到期还有两个星期___，不用着急。
zh: 离房租到期还有两个星期呢，不用着急。
py: lí fáng zū dào qī hái yǒu liǎng gè xīng qī ne bù yòng zháo jí
en: There are still two weeks until the rent is due, so there's no need to hurry.
why: 还有 + time with 呢 shows that the event is still far away. 吗 would turn it into a question, which clashes with 不用着急.

task: Say it is almost dark, using 快.
zh: 天快黑了。
py: tiān kuài hēi le
en: It's almost dark.
why: Adding 快 before the adjective turns "it has got dark" into "it is about to get dark"; the final 了 stays.

s: 这个月的房租快是五千块了。
s_py: zhè gè yuè de fáng zū kuài shì wǔ qiān kuài le
zh: 这个月的房租快五千块了。
py: zhè gè yuè de fáng zū kuài wǔ qiān kuài le
en: This month's rent is almost five thousand yuan.
why: 快 stands directly before the amount with no 是, and 了 closes the sentence.

q: 修这间房子，我们已经花了___五万块。
zh: 修这间房子，我们已经花了快五万块。
py: xiū zhè jiān fáng zi wǒ men yǐ jīng huā le kuài wǔ wàn kuài
en: We have already spent almost fifty thousand yuan on fixing up this flat.
why: 快 before an amount means "nearly". 才 would mean "only", which contradicts 已经, and 刚 and 是 do not mean "almost".

q: 我的手机快没电___，我去买个充电器。
zh: 我的手机快没电了，我去买个充电器。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī kuài méi diàn le wǒ qù mǎi gè chōng diàn qì
en: My phone is about to run out of battery; I'm going to buy a charger.
why: 快没电 describes a change that is about to arrive and must end in 了. 的 and 着 leave the clause unfinished.

q: 饭还没做好___，你再等一下。
zh: 饭还没做好呢，你再等一下。
py: fàn hái méi zuò hǎo ne nǐ zài děng yī xià
en: Dinner isn't ready yet; wait a bit longer.
why: "Not yet" is 还没 + verb with 呢, not a negative of 快…了. 了 after 还没 would contradict it.

zh: 我们明天就要搬家了。
py: wǒ men míng tiān jiù yào bān jiā le
en: We're moving house tomorrow.
why: The time word comes before 就要, which sits right before the verb. 就要 cannot come before 明天.

q: 我们周末___搬家了，东西还没收拾好。
zh: 我们周末就要搬家了，东西还没收拾好。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò jiù yào bān jiā le dōng xi hái méi shōu shi hǎo
en: We're moving house this weekend and nothing is packed yet.
why: 周末 is a specific time, so 就要…了. 快 and 快要 only mean "soon" and do not combine with a named time.

q: 天快黑___，路上小心。
zh: 天快黑了，路上小心。
py: tiān kuài hēi le lù shàng xiǎo xīn
en: It's almost dark; be careful on the road.
why: 快 + adjective needs the final 了 for the change that is arriving. 着 and 过 do not express a coming change.

q: 我们在这个小区住了___十年了。
zh: 我们在这个小区住了快十年了。
py: wǒ men zài zhè gè xiǎo qū zhù le kuài shí nián le
en: We've lived in this neighbourhood for almost ten years.
why: 快 directly before a length of time means "nearly". 刚 and 才 mean "just" and "only", and 是 cannot sit between 了 and a number here.

zh: 楼上的邻居下个星期就要搬走了。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū xià gè xīng qī jiù yào bān zǒu le
en: The neighbour upstairs is moving out next week.
why: The time word goes before 就要; the time word may precede or follow the subject, and 了 comes last.

q: 租的房子快要到期___，我们得重新找房子。
zh: 租的房子快要到期了，我们得重新找房子。
py: zū de fáng zi kuài yào dào qī le wǒ men děi chóng xīn zhǎo fáng zi
en: The lease on our flat is about to expire, so we'll have to look for a new place.
why: The lease has not expired yet, so the pattern 快要…了 is needed. 过 would say it already expired, and then there would be no point in saying 快要.

src_py: wǒ men bān jìn xīn jiā le
task: Say the move is about to happen, using 就要.
zh: 我们就要搬进新家了。
py: wǒ men jiù yào bān jìn xīn jiā le
en: We're about to move into our new home.
why: 就要 goes before 搬进, turning the finished move into one that is about to happen; the final 了 remains.

q: 快点！电影___开始了，我们还没买到票。
zh: 快点！电影要开始了，我们还没买到票。
py: kuài diǎn diàn yǐng yào kāi shǐ le wǒ men hái méi mǎi dào piào
en: Hurry! The film is about to start and we haven't got tickets yet.
why: The film has not started yet, so 要…了 is needed. 开始了 alone would say it has started, which does not fit the urgency.

q: 下个月我们___有新邻居了，听说是一家四口。
zh: 下个月我们就要有新邻居了，听说是一家四口。
py: xià gè yuè wǒ men jiù yào yǒu xīn lín jū le tīng shuō shì yī jiā sì kǒu
en: Next month we'll have new neighbours; I hear it's a family of four.
why: 下个月 is a specific time, so 就要…了 is the right form. 快 and 快要 are vague and clash with a named month.

zh: 她学做饭快一年了。
py: tā xué zuò fàn kuài yī nián le
en: She has been learning to cook for almost a year.
why: 快 sits directly before the length of time 一年 with no verb in between, and 了 ends the sentence.

q: 打折活动快要结束___，现在买最便宜。
zh: 打折活动快要结束了，现在买最便宜。
py: dǎ zhé huó dòng kuài yào jié shù le xiàn zài mǎi zuì pián yi
en: The sale is about to end; it's cheapest to buy now.
why: 快要结束 needs 了 at the end. 过 would mean the sale has already ended, which clashes with 现在买最便宜.

q: 楼上的邻居快要搬走___，我们终于可以安静一点了。
zh: 楼上的邻居快要搬走了，我们终于可以安静一点了。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū kuài yào bān zǒu le wǒ men zhōng yú kě yǐ ān jìng yī diǎn le
en: The neighbour upstairs is about to move out, so we can finally have some quiet.
why: 快要 + verb takes a closing 了. 着 would describe a continuing state and 过 a past experience; neither fits the news that a move is about to happen.

s: 老板就要明天回来了。
s_py: lǎo bǎn jiù yào míng tiān huí lái le
zh: 老板明天就要回来了。
py: lǎo bǎn míng tiān jiù yào huí lái le
en: The boss is coming back tomorrow.
why: The time word must come before 就要, which stays right in front of the verb. 就要 cannot be followed by a time word.

q: 邻居的货车已经停在楼下了，他们___搬走了，你想借东西就快点去。
zh: 邻居的货车已经停在楼下了，他们快要搬走了，你想借东西就快点去。
py: lín jū de huò chē yǐ jīng tíng zài lóu xià le tā men kuài yào bān zǒu le nǐ xiǎng jiè dōng xi jiù kuài diǎn qù
en: The neighbours' lorry is already downstairs and they are about to move out, so go quickly if you want to borrow something.
why: They have not left yet, as the advice to hurry shows, so 快要…了 is needed. 已经搬走了 or 搬走了 would mean they are already gone.

q: 下个月一号，我们租的房子___到期了，所以得提前找新房子。
zh: 下个月一号，我们租的房子就要到期了，所以得提前找新房子。
py: xià gè yuè yī hào wǒ men zū de fáng zi jiù yào dào qī le suǒ yǐ děi tí qián zhǎo xīn fáng zi
en: On the first of next month our rented flat expires, so we have to find a new place in advance.
why: 下个月一号 is a specific date, so 就要…了 is needed. 快 and 快要 would only say "soon" and cannot take a date.

q: 电梯门要关___，快进来！
zh: 电梯门要关了，快进来！
py: diàn tī mén yào guān le kuài jìn lái
en: The lift door is about to close; come in quickly!
why: The door is about to close, which is a situation arriving now, so 要 must be closed by 了. Without 了 the sentence reads incomplete.
